nodes.description: Private owner address of the Ownable contract, set in constructor and updated by transferOwnership/renounceOwnership.
Mapping of account balances, mutated by _transfer, _mint and _burn.
Nested mapping of owner=>spender=>amount, mutated by _approve.
Total token supply, increased by _mint and decreased by _burn.
Address allowed to mint tokens and bypass allowance deduction; set by owner via setIdolsAddress.
Public function that mints arbitrary amounts to any account when caller equals _idolsAddres.
Spends allowance and transfers tokens, skipping allowance deduction when caller is _idolsAddres.
Transfers tokens from msg.sender to recipient.
Sets allowance from msg.sender to a spender.
Burns tokens from msg.sender balance and reduces total supply.
Increases the caller's allowance for a spender using SafeMath.add.
Decreases the caller's allowance for a spender using SafeMath.sub.
Internal transfer routine validating zero addresses and updating _balances.
Internal mint routine updating _totalSupply and _balances.
Internal burn routine updating _balances and _totalSupply.
Internal allowance setter writing _allowances.
Owner-only setter that stores the privileged minting/bypass address.
Owner-only function transferring ownership to newOwner.
Owner-only function setting the owner to the zero address.
Caller-controlled address consumed by every public entry point and by the onlyOwner modifier.
Unbounded token mint callable by any address that equals _idolsAddres, which is a single external contract under EOA owner control.
Allowance check is conditionally skipped in transferFrom when msg.sender == _idolsAddres, enabling privileged moving of other users' tokens.
Destination account for newly minted tokens in mintTokens.
Amount of tokens to mint in mintTokens.

edges.reason: msg.sender is compared against _idolsAddres to authorize minting, making the privilege check caller-controlled.
msg.sender decides whether the allowance deduction branch is executed inside transferFrom.
msg.sender is used as the source address passed to _transfer.
msg.sender becomes the owner whose allowance is written in _approve.
msg.sender is the account whose balance is burned.
msg.sender allowance is read and increased in increaseAllowance.
msg.sender allowance is read and decreased in decreaseAllowance.
onlyOwner modifier requires owner() == _msgSender() before setIdolsAddress runs.
onlyOwner modifier gates transferOwnership execution.
onlyOwner modifier gates renounceOwnership execution.
_idolsAddres is read as the sole authorization source for minting.
_idolsAddres is read to decide whether to skip the allowance check.
setIdolsAddress writes the privileged _idolsAddres state variable.
_transfer reads and writes _balances for sender and recipient.
_mint increases _balances[account].
_burn decreases _balances[account].
_approve writes the _allowances mapping.
_mint increases _totalSupply.
_burn decreases _totalSupply.
transferOwnership reassigns the _owner state variable.
renounceOwnership clears the _owner state variable.
transfer delegates to the internal _transfer routine.
transferFrom delegates to the internal _transfer routine.
transferFrom conditionally calls _approve to reduce allowance when caller is not _idolsAddres.
burn delegates to the internal _burn routine.
approve delegates to the internal _approve routine.
increaseAllowance delegates to _approve with an increased value.
decreaseAllowance delegates to _approve with a decreased value.
mintTokens calls the internal _mint routine after the _idolsAddres check.
mintTokens performs the unsafe arbitrary mint operation guarded only by _idolsAddres.
transferFrom performs the unsafe allowance-bypass operation when caller is _idolsAddres.
The unsafe mint operation flows into _mint, increasing supply without owner approval.
The allowance-bypass operation results in an unvalidated _approve/transfer path.
account parameter is forwarded to _mint as the mint destination.
amount parameter is forwarded to _mint, allowing caller-influenced supply inflation.
sender parameter is forwarded to _transfer.
recipient parameter is forwarded to _transfer.
amount parameter is forwarded to _transfer.
amount parameter is used to subtract from the allowance in _approve.
spender parameter is written into the allowance mapping via _approve.
amount parameter becomes the allowance value in _approve.
newOwner parameter overwrites the _owner state variable.

Parameter is forwarded unchanged into the internal _transfer routine.
Parameter is forwarded into _transfer and used for the allowance subtraction.
Parameter is only consumed by the internal _approve allowance setter.
Parameter becomes the allowance value written by the internal _approve setter.
